text:
jen-support: P1 from a Dedicated VPC customer after LB upgrade — their SSO-backed requests are getting 401s. Flow: GCP ILB -> HAProxy edge -> dedicated gateway (istio). They expect the LB/edge to rewrite cookie to Authorization: Bearer <token> for the backend, but the backend is seeing no Authorization header. Anyone seen auth headers stripped in this path?

devon-eng-infra: can you paste a minimal repro request and any access logs? also confirm if Istio ext_authz is in the path.

jen-support: Customer provided a curl they used to reproduce (redacted token):
```
curl -v -H "Cookie: SSO=eyJhbGci..." \ "https://api.customer.internal/echo-auth"
```
They expect gateway to receive Authorization: Bearer <token> (edge should translate cookie -> header). Instead backend logs show no Authorization header and ext_authz returns 401.

jen-support: Envoy access log snippet from gateway pod (headers):
```
":method" "GET" ":path" "/echo-auth" ":authority" "api.customer.internal"
"cookie": "SSO=eyJhb..."
"authorization": "-"
"x-forwarded-for": "10.128.0.5"
```

devon-eng-infra: interesting — that implies the header was removed between HAProxy and the gateway or at ingress routing. Can you tcpdump on the gateway node to check the raw TCP packet from HAProxy? If Authorization arrives on the wire but disappears before envoy, likely an envoy header manipulation. If it never arrives, HAProxy is the culprit.

jen-support: did tcpdump from HAProxy -> gateway IP. We see Authorization on the incoming packet to HAProxy, but on the packet arriving at the gateway pod it's absent. Hex excerpt (token censored):
```
... Authorization: Bearer abcd******
... -> missing on dst packet
```

leila-eng-platform: two quick things we've hit before: GCP internal LBs + backend proxies sometimes rewrite or normalize headers when SSL is terminated at an intermediate. Also HAProxy configs often include `http-request del-header Authorization` for security — double-check their edge policy. On Istio side, an Authorization header can be translated into metadata or moved to X-Auth-Token by ext_authz filters if misconfigured.

devon-eng-infra: agree. ask customer to dump HAProxy config and check for `http-request set-header` / `del-header` rules. Also check whether they enabled proxy-protocol; mismatch in proxy protocol decoding can reorder payloads making headers appear missing.

jen-support: customer confirms HAProxy was updated with an ACL that intentionally removes Authorization for certain routes during SSL offload. They added a temporary change to COPY instead of DEL. We suggested a quick workaround: copy Authorization into X-Original-Authorization so we can map it on our gateway.

mike-oncall: escalation/playbook: (1) get packet capture showing header present at HAProxy egress and missing at gateway ingress, (2) recommend customer copy Authorization->X-Original-Authorization or keep SSL termination at origin, (3) we can add an Envoy header_to_metadata mapping in the dedicated gateway config to read X-Original-Authorization and feed ext_authz until customer fixes edge config. tagging infra to review `preserve_auth` flags. :white_check_mark:

jen-support: implemented temporary mapping on customer's dedicated gateway and asked HAProxy to copy header. Customer reports immediate 200s and no more 401s. We'll keep workaround until infra confirms a permanent fix. :thumbsup:

oauth-bot: note: if you fall back to passing cookies and performing token introspection at the gateway, ensure the introspection client sets `token_type_hint=access_token` and that the gateway converts cookie value to bearer when calling introspection. Otherwise some introspect endpoints will reject without a Bearer prefix.

customer-cs: confirming from the customer: "copying Authorization -> X-Original-Authorization and mapping it at gateway solved the issue. We'll revert the HAProxy deletion rule in our next maintenance window." They attached logs and said to proceed with permanent remediation.

leila-eng-platform: we'll add a permanent checklist item in the Dedicated onboarding doc: verify Authorization passthrough across LB -> edge proxy -> gateway. Also filing a follow-up ticket for infra to add an automated probe that tests Authorization header passthrough for new customer configs.

jen-support: closing loop here — workaround succeeded, customer stable. Will keep the ticket open for infra follow-up and add notes to the KB with exact tcpdump + envoy snippets for future triage.
